notes: 'them' in 'gird them with sackcloth' is added: חָגַר is Qal, so no voice licenses a reflexive and no object morpheme stands in the clause (rule 44); the 'with' reaching the bare object שַׂקִּים stays with the verb.
The cognate accusative קָרְחָה keeps 'bald' while the Hiphil keeps 'shall make themselves'; the competing reading gives 'make ... bald' to the verb and leaves the cognate noun unrepresented.
